name: readable-contract-fields
goal: Each contract field appears once with its recorded description; missing descriptions remain explicit.

evidence: Fresh candidate overview repeated each described field name. Show each once, retaining every field of partially described contracts.
Two existing component/contract tests failed on duplicate labels and the missing undescribed tab field before repair; 16 other tests passed.
Grouped fields render once with explicit missing descriptions; scoped block layout prevents the native host grid from squeezing nested values.
Nineteen contract tests and thirteen shared browser checks pass, including the unchanged raw-array admission guard and six desktop/tablet/mobile layout regressions.

Reports check passed 553 tests; 19 contract, 16 wiring/import, and 13 browser checks passed. Desktop/tablet/mobile captures were inspected; root format, types, lint, audit and registry passed. Independent review found no blocking issues.
